mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, change_kind, impacted_user_count, version_bumped_count, profile_refreshed_count, profile_evicted_count, processed_at FROM auth_authorization_invalidation_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_authorization_invalidation_event (id, event_id, change_kind, impacted_user_count, version_bumped_count, profile_refreshed_count, profile_evicted_count, processed_at, create_time, update_time, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventId}, #{changeKind}, #{impactedUserCount}, #{versionBumpedCount}, #{profileRefreshedCount}, #{profileEvictedCount}, #{processedAt}, #{processedAt}, #{processedAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_authorization_invalidation_event SET impacted_user_count = #{impactedUserCount}, version_bumped_count = #{versionBumpedCount}, profile_refreshed_count = #{profileRefreshedCount}, profile_evicted_count = #{profileEvictedCount}, processed_at = #{processedAt}, update_time = #{processedAt} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND impacted_user_count = -1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM auth_authorization_invalidation_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND impacted_user_count = -1
